artBrief: **Romantic anime magic.** A small witch and an open spellbook under a crescent moon, with a ring of seven clear stars. Soft violet and warm gold.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Romantic anime magic. A small witch and an open spellbook under a crescent moon, with a ring of seven clear stars. Soft violet and warm gold. A small original witch, large open book and crescent moon dominate the scene. Exactly seven separate golden star shapes arranged in a clear loose circle, no other star-shaped marks.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
